title: Integrity Validation & Mutation Guard
objective: Prove exact work-history/dependency coverage and guard it against silent mutation before PCV-PRE resumes.
acceptance: 83 planning groups, 73 work-state families, 662 unique work items and 667 attempt files match the archaeology inventory exactly.
Every work item maps to exactly one family; every family has an explicit planning/lineage parent or an explicitly preserved standalone lineage.
All 71 current-canon/current-intent entries and all 56 PCV-01 capability rows are represented.
Known non-work-state families and Project Source/archive lineages are first-class records.
Every integrity gap and child scoped gap register has an owner/route; no silent zero-gap claim overrides later evidence.
Mutation policy and validator prohibit silent rename/delete/reclassification.
OPS3, archaeology validation and project-integrity validation pass on the exact candidate.
next_action: PCV-I01A is the strict successor; no product runtime implementation is authorized.
